response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and excellent craftsmanship practices, he lacks the core technical prerequisites for this role. His Java experience is minimal and outdated (last used in 2015), with no evidence of Kotlin expertise, Spring ecosystem knowledge, or deep JVM understanding. His recent 4+ years of focus on TypeScript/Node.js and web technologies represent a significant departure from enterprise Java/JVM development. The role explicitly requires strong expertise in Java, Kotlin, Spring, and enterprise frameworks—areas where this candidate would need substantial ramp-up rather than bringing ready expertise.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship foundation with proven expertise in TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture, and code quality across complex systems
Demonstrated ability to work on large-scale codebases and complex systems including microservices, real-time applications, and distributed platforms
Excellent communication skills with track record of knowledge-sharing through conference talks, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: Minimal and severely outdated Java experience (last used 2015, 11+ years ago) with zero Kotlin knowledge, representing critical gaps in primary language requirements
Complete absence of Spring ecosystem, Hibernate, enterprise framework, and application server experience despite these being explicitly required
Recent technical trajectory focused on TypeScript/Node.js and web technologies for 4+ years suggests potential skill drift away from JVM-based enterprise development
